channel.title: Botswana - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Botswana, every source cited.

item.title: Gaborone mortgages near 94% of property value
item.description: A P1 million property with a P937,000 mortgage leaves owners with only P63,000 equity.

item.title: Cheetah Cement plans 800,000-tonne Gaborone plant
item.description: The expansion could boost domestic cement production and reduce reliance on imports.

item.title: Botswana boxers win three medals in DRC
item.description: The team secured two bronze medals and a chance at gold in their return to the IBA Africa Elite Championships.

item.title: Botswana UDC government reverses free education pledge
item.description: Diamond revenue collapse forces the Umbrella for Democratic Change to retain secondary school fees.
